For each actual selected path, check real list generic declaration, model runtime element types and original payload row count

For callback 47, check actual List<GlobalMainCityMapInfo>, List<GlobalMapInfo> and Dictionary<string,GlobalMapInfo> declarations; nested row/unique tile-key counts and dictionary object identity

Require raw and decoded bytes to equal the stage-23 81-resource original audit

Actual pending list converges to zero and actual selected list has 65 entries
The native verification map and original resource audit are available
Exactly 65 selected typed checks pass, including original byte/readback validation

failureAndInterruption: Record original exception, pending paths, last real counts, relevant Unity logs and elapsed time

neverAsserted: AB grouping initialization is confirmed; abContextConfirmed stays false
